SHARED DESIGN LANGUAGE: tokens navy-950 #060a14 / brand-500 #6f47f5 / brand-400 #8a70fb / accent-blue #3b82f6 / accent-cyan #22d3ee, Geist, `grad-text`, `.card`, `.btn-primary`/`.btn-deploy`, `hero-aura`, glass + violet glow; cyan = "live" pop, never amber except warnings. Real product-screens as centerpiece; asymmetric/editorial layouts (NOT centered-stack); animated "live" elements; compact 5-star review element where it fits; buying-psychology focus; LESS text MORE presentation. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; mobile-responsive (390w). FORBIDDEN (rejected slop): centered-stack→particle-canvas→3-up-grid skeleton; fake globes; dead-space cards; text walls. Reusable showcase components in `components/marketing/showcase/` (esp. `DnsManager`, `VolumesPanel`, and any DomainChecker) + `DeployCard`, `NetworkMap`. Reuse/evolve them.

**Template 1 — Domains landing (`/preview/domains`, component under `components/marketing/domainstemplate/`):** register/transfer domains. Hero centerpiece: an animated **domain search** element — a search bar that "checks" a domain and shows availability + a TLD price grid populating (evolve any DomainChecker showcase). Add transfer/DNS-tools angle, an "everything in one account (domain + hosting + email)" bundling story, plan/TLD pricing, compact reviews.

**Template 2 — NxCloud / private cloud (`/preview/nxcloud`, component under `components/marketing/nxcloudtemplate/`):** managed Nextcloud — private file sync, Office, Talk. Hero: an animated file-sync / private-cloud visual (evolve `VolumesPanel` or a files UI — files syncing, a clean cloud dashboard). The story: your own private Google-Drive/Office alternative, managed. Add feature showcase (sync/Office/Talk/storage), plan cards, compact reviews.

**Template 3 — Tool page (`/preview/tool`, component under `components/marketing/tooltemplate/`):** a single free-tool page (do a Minecraft Server Status checker OR a Port Checker — pick one). The interactive tool sits **front-and-center in a premium glass frame** (a working-looking input + result panel, animated result state — you can mock the result data, it's a template preview). Add a short "how it works", a related-tools rail, and a **"deploy a server on Nxeon" CTA** (tools are top-of-funnel — convert the visitor). These tool pages get cited by ChatGPT, so keep them clean, fast-looking, and useful.

CONCURRENCY CONSTRAINTS (7 agents share this tree): NET-NEW files only; do NOT touch existing live pages/shared components/MarketingHeader/GameLandingPage (READ OK). **Do NOT edit `app/globals.css`** — use co-located CSS Modules (`*.module.css`) or inline; REUSE existing `pv-*` keyframes. `npx tsc --noEmit` clean. Do NOT run `npm run build` and do NOT run a dev server / screenshots (main session does one pass). Report the 3 route paths + concerns.
